ng-new.description: A new Juicebox admin in one step: Angular's ng new (SCSS, no server-side rendering), then ng-add, with this package at its version and an .npmrc for its registry

ng-add.description: Turns a new Angular app into a Juicebox admin: provideJuicebar with users and exports, lib styles and assets, config.json

module.description: Adds a module in the library's shape (listing with the split view, record page, create dialog, service, labels) to a Juicebox admin, or with --lib to the library itself
